ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 为什么……不能举办祭典了啊！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 有——咲！早上好！！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
对了，有咲，今天的练习！
是大家一起合奏昨天的曲子吧？好期待！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
因为我很期待嘛。
我想快点弹吉他啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
诶嘿嘿。
……再见啦，有咲！等会见！
一起加油练习吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
赶上啦~！
沙绫、小里美、惠惠！早上好！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 诶嘿嘿，因为熬夜，所以睡过头了……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 吉他！我在练习吉他哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……啊——！我忘记了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 好了，老师！我做完了！终于做完了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嘻嘻嘻。午休的时候让有咲教我的！
因为我想快点练习！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯！乐队！我们有在组乐队哦！
Poppin'Party！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
大家，对不起！久等了……啊，咦？
没有声音……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
唔、嗯。
可是……大家，你们怎么了？练习呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯！好——今天也要加油哦~！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
耶——！
刚才的演奏是不是很棒。是吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好啊！那个。
哼哼~♪啦啦啦……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好奇怪啊……
惠惠~！怎么办！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
怎、怎么会呢~！
我也教给了明日香很多东西哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这样啊。不过，我很喜欢哦！
小里美现在的贝斯演奏

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
是啊。
因为，正因为有小里美在――
正因为那个人是小里美，我们才是Poppin'Party嘛
